finding.headline: "Adding Newborn to NHIS/HMO Before the Window Closes"
finding.problem: "The hospital knows the baby exists, so surely insurance does too? Then the bill came. I didn't know I had to enrol him myself."
finding.person: Nigerian mum on an HMO/NHIS whose baby needs the 6-week pediatric visits + vaccines covered, but she doesn't know she must formally add the newborn or face out-of-pocket.
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Standalone product (NHIS/HMO newborn enrolment guide) + Module.". Verdict: PASSES.
